thread:
mia: Heads-up — holding PR #21480 for the rebase window to avoid landing into the Friday deploy freeze. CI backlog is growing and integration-postgres is consistently failing. Ping me if you need it forced through earlier.

ashwin: Which job is flaking? e2e or integration?

mia: integration-postgres. Failing on schema apply step repeatedly. Full logs: https://ci.redwood.example/21480/logs (private). Also need to rebase on main to pick up the schema-migration fix we merged earlier.

joanne: @mia I can take the rebase tomorrow morning PST. Want me to trigger an integration rerun after the rebase?

ashwin: If we rebase, do we expect a canary? We're in the pre-freeze window so prefer to land Monday unless it's a hotfix. Suggest schedule landing Mon 08:30 UTC if green.

mia: Plan: rebase + force-push, then rerun only the integration-postgres job. If green, ask @release-owner to land at Mon 08:30 UTC (outside freeze). If it stays red, keep the branch open and escalate to infra for deeper investigation. Rebase steps: ```git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease```

ci-bot: CI rerun requested by joanne for PR #21480. Job integration-postgres queued (position 12). Estimated wait ~45m.

joanne: :thumbsup: kicking the rerun now and I'll tag @release-owner once it's green.

mia: Thanks — I won't try to merge before Monday unless we get a clear green and an explicit go from release team. If anything unexpected shows up, call me.

ashwin: Sounds good. I'll keep an eye on the queue and help with rebase conflicts if they show up.
